Confirmed — `AbstractGatewayDeviceSessionContext` calls `parent.deregisterSession(String)`, a different overload on the gateway handler, not `TransportService.deregisterSession(SessionInfoProto)`. It is excluded.

Here are all callers of `TransportService.deregisterSession(SessionInfoProto)`:
